'''Cyberscanner limbs''' were artificial [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] that included scanning devices. The [[Mod IV Scanner Limb]] was one such limb.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
